## About
Body Pros Collision is an auto body shop on May St. in Charlotte. The work covers collision and paint repairs, frame straightening, welding, dent repair and glass replacement, with a computerized laser system used to measure and align unibody and frame damage.
The goal on every job is the same: restore the vehicle to factory specifications using the very best equipment and paint. We conduct our business honestly, with integrity, and we take pride in what we do.
The shop is run by John, the owner, with Shontell as administrator, as one reviewer noted. Body Pros Collision holds a 4.4 rating from 102 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto Body / Heavy Duty Collision & Paint Repairs: Body and paint repair after a collision, including heavy duty damage.
- Computerized Unibody & Frame Laser Measurement & Alignment System: Laser measurement and alignment of unibody and frame structures after an impact.
- Dent Repair: Repair of dents in body panels.
- Custom Paint Jobs: Custom paint work for your vehicle.
- Full Frame Straightening: Straightening of bent or damaged frames.
- Scratch Removal / Detailing: Scratch removal and detailing to clean up the finish.
- Windshield and Glass Replacement: Replacement of windshields and other vehicle glass.
- Paintless Dent Repair (PDR): Dent repair using paintless techniques.

## FAQ
Q: Do you repair frame damage?
A: Yes. Full frame straightening is one of our listed services, along with computerized laser measurement and alignment.

Q: Do you offer paintless dent repair?
A: Yes. Paintless Dent Repair (PDR) is on our list of services, along with standard dent repair.
